# openwebui_file (Data Source)

Looks up an uploaded file by its UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openwebui_file" "doc" {
  file_id = "3b2d5c7a-1e4f-4b8c-9d0a-6f5e4d3c2b1a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String) UUID of the file to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the file was uploaded.
- `data_json` (String) JSON data blob associated with the file as returned by Open WebUI.
- `filename` (String) Original filename as stored by Open WebUI.
- `hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the file content.
- `id` (String) UUID of the file. Set after lookup.
- `meta_json` (String) JSON metadata blob associated with the file as returned by Open WebUI.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of when the file record was last updated.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the Open WebUI account that owns this object.
